subagents.for: Medium-breadth sweep to map existing React components, Mongoose connection helpers, and current Vitest/pnpm layout before any design work.
Design the three-entry-point package surface (widget/server/admin), exports map, and WebSocket-plus-poll transport across 15+ files.
One isolated context per package — widget React + useChatSocket, server Mongoose models/handlers, admin inbox UI — so the three builds don't cross-contaminate context.
Audit session tokens, upload handlers, cross-origin embedding, and the siteId tenant filter before the first pnpm publish.
Final pass over the diff for exports-map correctness, index coverage on the Mongoose schemas, and Vitest gaps.

skills.name: /init
skills.when: Once at the start to generate the token-lean CLAUDE.md the plan calls for (pnpm only, colocated Vitest, no barrel re-exports).

skills.name: /security-review
skills.when: After the server handlers land and again before the first npm publish, since sessions, uploads, and multi-tenant queries are all in scope.

skills.name: /review
skills.when: On the PR to github.com/proffesergio/livechat-bridge once all three entry points are implemented and tests pass.

skills.name: /clear
skills.when: Between the widget, server, and admin build phases so each package starts with a clean context window.

skills.name: /loop
skills.when: To poll the .github/workflows/ci.yml run after the first push to the new remote.

skills.name: /memory
skills.when: Right after the approval gate, to persist package name, entry-point split, and the siteId tenant key so they survive /clear.

hooks_to_consider.for: Run Prettier (and tsc --noEmit) on every .ts/.tsx edit so formatting never shows up in the PR diff.
Gate `git push` to the new remote and `pnpm publish` behind confirmation while allowlisting `pnpm test`, `pnpm vitest`, and `git status`.
Load the pnpm workspace conventions and current package build state so each cleared session starts oriented.
Notify when the backgrounded `pnpm vitest --watch` run or a long CI poll finishes.

execution_order: 1. Enter Plan Mode; run /init to create the token-lean CLAUDE.md, and dispatch the Explore subagent (medium breadth) to map existing React components, Mongoose connection helpers, and Vitest setup.

2. Hand findings to the Plan subagent to design the workspace: package.json exports map for livechat-bridge/{widget,server,admin}, src/types.ts contracts, and the WebSocket-first + HTTP-poll transport.
3. ExitPlanMode to confirm the three approval items — package name, entry-point split, and the siteId multi-tenant key — then store them via /memory.
4. Configure hooks and permissions through the update-config skill: PostToolUse Prettier, allowlist pnpm test / git status, gate git push and pnpm publish.
5. TaskCreate three tracked tasks (widget, server, admin) and start `pnpm vitest --watch` as a background agent.

6. Build the server package first — Conversation/Message/Agent Mongoose schemas with compound siteId indexes, then messages/sessions/upload handlers — writing the siteId-isolation Vitest case before the query code.
7. Build src/widget/useChatSocket.ts and ChatWidget.tsx with reconnect tests; run the transport-fallback (HTTP long-poll) experiment in an isolated worktree and merge only if it passes.
8. Build src/admin/AgentInbox.tsx and ConversationList.tsx against the shared src/types.ts contracts; TaskUpdate each package to done as its tests go green.
9. Wire src/index.ts, README.md, and .github/workflows/ci.yml; run the simplify skill over the full diff.
10. Run /security-review (sessions, uploads, cross-origin embed, tenant scoping), then push to the new remote and /review the PR; /loop the CI run until green before pnpm publish.
recipe.rationale: This is a greenfield multi-package build where the three entry points are genuinely independent once the shared src/types.ts contract is fixed, so the leverage is in front-loading Plan Mode plus an explicit approval gate, then fanning out one isolated agent per package with /clear between phases. Security is not an afterthought here — session tokens, uploads, and the siteId tenant filter each need a dedicated review pass with a proving Vitest case rather than a single sweep at the end. Hooks and a permission allowlist keep the loop tight: Prettier runs automatically, pnpm test runs unprompted, and only git push and pnpm publish stop to ask.
